paper: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory (Wu et al., ICLR 2025; arXiv:2410.10813)
selection: deterministic stratified round-robin over question_type (RNG-free); tiers nest as prefixes of one global order
ordering: sessions emitted chronologically (sorted by timestamp); haystacks capped to 6 sessions (evidence kept)
note: episodes.jsonl is gitignored — regenerate via `python scripts/build_longmemeval.py --tier sample`
